questions.q:
The five-digit number 45yz0 is divisible by 40. What is the maximum possible value of (y + z)?

पांच अंकों की संख्या 45yz0, 40 से विभाज्य है। (y + z) का अधिकतम संभावित मान क्या है?
questions.s:
For divisibility by 40, note that:

   - The number ends with 0 (so it is divisible by 5).

   - The last three digits must be divisible by 8.

Write the last three digits as:

  100y + 10z.

  Since 100 ≡ 4 (mod 8) and 10 ≡ 2 (mod 8), the condition becomes:

  4y + 2z ≡ 0 (mod 8).

Divide the equation by 2:

  2y + z ≡ 0 (mod 4).

Test high-digit possibilities:

   - For y = 9: 2 X 9 + z = 18 + z must be divisible by 4.

   If z = 6, then 18 + 6 = 24 (divisible by 4); sum = 9 + 6 = 15.

   - For y = 8: 2 X 8 + z = 16 + z must be divisible by 4.

   If z = 8, then 16 + 8 = 24; sum = 8 + 8 = 16.

The maximum sum is 16.

Option (c) is the correct answer.

if we take y = 2 then 87y = 872 which is divisible by 8, hence we got y = 2

For expression 89x6402087y to be divisible by 9,

questions.q:
For what least value of n, 22n + 2n is completely divided by 6, where n is an integer?

n के किस न्यूनतम मान के लिए 22n + 2n, 6 से पूर्णतः विभाजित होगा, जहाँ n एक पूर्णांक है?
questions.s:
A number is divisible by 6 if it is divisible by both 2 and 3

A number is divisible by 2 if it is even.

Since 2n is always even for any integer n, the sum 22n + 2n will be even if 22n is even.

Since 22n is a power of 22, and 22 is even, it follows that 22n is also always even.

Thus, 22n + 2n is always even, meaning it is divisible by 2.

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3

Since 22 = 1(mod 3), we get

22n - 1n = 1 (mod 3)

Since 2 = 2(mod 3), we get

2n = 2n mod 3)

For divisibility by 3, we need

22n + 2n = 1 + 2n = 0 (mod 3)

1 + 2n = 0 (mod 3)

2n = -1 = 2 (mod 3)

Checking the powers of 2 module 3

21 = 2(mod 3) [satisfy]

22 = 4 = 1(mod 3) [does not satisfy]

23 = 8 = 2 (mod 3) [satisfy]

24 = 16 = 1 (mod 3) [does not satisfy]

Observing the pattern, 2n = 2(mod 3) when n is odd

Smallest n to satisfy both condition,

22n + 2n is even

2n = 2 (mod 3), meaning n is odd

The smallest odd integer is n = 1

questions.q: 12. If a seven digit number 53345xy is divisible by 40, for some possible value of x and y, then the one value of (2x - 5y) is:
questions.s:
12.(a)

For 53345xy is divisible by 40, given expression must be divisible by 10 and 4.

For 53345xy is divisible by 10, the unit digit of the given expression must be 0. Hence we got y = 0.

For 53345xy is divisible by 4, last two digits of the given expression must be either zero or divisible by 4, in this case putting y = 0 in given expression we get expression - 53345x0, so possible value of x = 0, 2, 4, 6, 8

For x = 0 and y = 0, we get [2x – 5y] = [2(0) – 5(0)] = 0

For x = 2 and y = 0, we get [2x – 5y] = [2(2) – 5(0)] = 4

For x = 4 and y = 0, we get [2x – 5y] = [2(4) – 5(0)] = 8

For x = 6 and y = 0, we get [2x – 5y] = [2(6) – 5(0)] = 12

For x = 8 and y = 0, we get [2x – 5y] = [2(8) – 5(0)] = 16

From options given in question, we can see that option (a) is correct.

questions.q:
The LCM of two numbers is 7 times the larger number. If the difference between smaller number and HCF of the numbers is 72, then find the HCF of the numbers.

दो संख्याओं का LCM बड़ी संख्या का 7 गुना है। यदि छोटी संख्या और संख्याओं के HCF के बीच का अंतर 72 है, तो संख्याओं का HCF ज्ञात करें।
questions.s:
Let smaller and larger number be 'm' and 'n' respectively.

So, LCM and HCF are 7n and (m - 72) respectively.

Since,

HCF * LCM = product of two numbers

(m - 72)*7n = m*n

7m - 504 = m

m = 504/6

m = 84

So, HCF of the numbers = 84 - 72 = 12

questions.q:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 167+116 is odd

II. 155-124 is even

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

I. 167+116 विषम है|

II. 155-124 सम है|
o: Both I and III और II दोनों
Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
questions.s:
I. 167+116

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So,

167will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 116 will be odd.

Sum of an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 167+116 is odd.

Hence, statement I is true.

II. 155-124

When an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So,

155 will be odd.

Similarly, when an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 124will be even.

Difference between an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 155-124 is odd.

Hence, statement II is wrong.

53345xy को 4 से विभाज्य होने के लिए अंतिम दो अंक या तो शून्य या 4 से विभाज्य होने चाहिए,

इस स्थिति में दिए गए व्यंजक में y = 0 रखने पर हमें व्यंजक - 53345x0 प्राप्त होता है, इसलिए x के संभावित मान = 0, 2, 4 , 6, 8

x = 0 और y = 0 के लिए,

हमें [2x – 5y] = [2(0) – 5(0)] = 0 प्राप्त होता है।

x = 2 और y = 0 के लिए,

x = 4 और y = 0 के लिए,

x = 8 और y = 0 के लिए,

questions_hin.q_hi:
The LCM of two numbers is 7 times the larger number. If the difference between smaller number and HCF of the numbers is 72, then find the HCF of the numbers.

दो संख्याओं का LCM बड़ी संख्या का 7 गुना है। यदि छोटी संख्या और संख्याओं के HCF के बीच का अंतर 72 है, तो संख्याओं का HCF ज्ञात करें।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let smaller and larger number be 'm' and 'n' respectively.

So, LCM and HCF are 7n and (m - 72) respectively.

Since,

HCF * LCM = product of two numbers

(m - 72)*7n = m*n

7m - 504 = m

m = 504/6

m = 84

So, HCF of the numbers = 84 - 72 = 12

questions_hin.q_hi:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 167+116 is odd

II. 155-124 is even

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

I. 167+116 विषम है|

II. 155-124 सम है|
o_hi: Both I and III और II दोनों
Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
questions_hin.s_hi:
I. 167+116

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So,

167will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 116 will be odd.

Sum of an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 167+116 is odd.

Hence, statement I is true.

II. 155-124

When an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So,

155 will be odd.

Similarly, when an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 124will be even.

Difference between an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 155-124 is odd.

Hence, statement II is wrong.
